totalNodesCount.description: The total number of trail nodes generated on the game field (per wave in the endless mode). Range: 5 to 25.

rotateNodesAroundUser.description: Whether the trail nodes rotate slowly around the player camera to increase visual search difficulty. 0 for false, 1 for true.

rotationSpeed.description: Rotation speed in degrees per second if rotateNodesAroundUser is active. Range: 1.0 to 20.0.

nodeDimension.description: The sequencing symbols and combination pattern, as an index: 0 numbers (1,2,3...), 1 letters (A,B,C...), 2 alternating numbers and letters (1,A,2,B...), 3 emojis. The names 'numbers', 'letters', 'alternating' and 'emojis' are also accepted.

arrowHelpfulness.description: Level of directional guidance. 0 for None (hard reticle only), 1 for Medium (off-screen directional arrow pointer), 2 for High (arrow pointer + on-screen target highlight circle).
